howto.name: Upload a JSON file or paste JSON
howto.text: Select a .json file up to 500 MB or paste JSON directly into the editor.

howto.name: Choose the rendering style
howto.text: Pick syntax-highlighted code view for developers or a table/tree view for structured data.

howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Click Convert. The JSON is rendered into a paginated, readable PDF with proper indentation and optional line numbers.

faq.a: Yes. The tool validates the JSON and shows a clear error message with the line number if the syntax is invalid.
Nested objects and arrays are indented with syntax highlighting. Collapsible sections are shown in the preview but expanded in the PDF.

faq.q: Can I convert JSON arrays into tables?
faq.a: Yes. Arrays of objects with consistent keys are rendered as a table, with keys as column headers and each object as a row.
